About DiscoveryTech Hub

Web Design & ICT Solutions Built for Nigeria

DiscoveryTech Hub, the technology division of DiscoveryHub, is an ICT solutions company based in Abuja, Nigeria. We deliver end-to-end digital services including web design and development, ICT training, graphic design, branding, printing, proposal writing, and ICT consultancy for businesses, organizations, and individuals across Nigeria and beyond.

From web development and branding to ICT training and consultancy, we provide everything you need under one roof, serving businesses across Nigeria and beyond.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What does DiscoveryTech Hub do?

DiscoveryTech Hub is an ICT solutions company in Abuja, Nigeria, and the technology division of DiscoveryHub. We offer web design and development, ICT training, graphic design, branding and identity, printing, proposal and report writing, and ICT consultancy for businesses, organizations, and individuals across Nigeria and beyond.

Where is DiscoveryTech Hub located?

We are based at Plot 740 Aminu Kano Crescent, Wuse 2, FCT Abuja, Abuja, Nigeria, and we also work with clients remotely.

What are your working hours?

We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM and on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

How do I get a quote?

Send your request through the Get a Quote page on this website, or email info@discoverytechhub.com. You can also call +234 904 746 5802 or +234 807 685 4730.

Do you offer ICT training for companies and individuals?

Yes. Our hands-on ICT training is open to individuals, students, and organizations, with levels from beginner to advanced and corporate training available. Courses cover programming, Microsoft Office, graphic design, web technologies, and cybersecurity basics.

How does a project with DiscoveryTech Hub work?

Every project follows six steps: Discover, Strategize, Design & Develop, Review & Refine, Deliver & Deploy, and Support & Grow.

Can I rent a meeting or training space from you?

Yes. The DiscoveryTech Hub space in Abuja seats up to 22 people and costs ₦80,000 for a full day, negotiable for multi-day bookings. See the Hub page for amenities and booking.
